LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to write words correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. spell words with double consonants correctly for clarity of writing
2. construct correct sentences using words with double consonants for cohesive writing

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing 13.4.1 Spelling

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing 13.4.1 Spelling

Teach
• Focus skill: spell words with double consonants correctly for clarity of writing.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing 13.4.1 Spelling
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to write words correctly?
2. How can we improve our spelling?
3. what went well and why?
4. what did not go well and why?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
